trap.label: contraste de aspecto
trap.wrong: By June we will have been signing the deal.
trap.right: By June we will have signed the deal.
trap.why: Em português “estaremos assinando” e “teremos assinado” se confundem. Ação concluída = will have + pp; duração = will have been + -ing.
